name: Drama
overview: Scripture reveals that drama often arises from sinful actions and discord among people, as seen in warnings against harmful speech and destructive conflict (Proverbs 20:19; Galatians 5:15). God’s justice is personal and individual, holding each soul accountable for its own sin rather than inheriting the iniquities of others (Ezekiel 18:20), while His protective presence offers peace and security to those who trust Him (Psalms 23:1; Psalms 91:1). The Lord’s jealousy for His people underscores the seriousness of idolatry and rebellion that can fuel ongoing strife (Exodus 20:5).
